svg.aria-label: L12 System level cache lineage: a victim cache grown to 8 MiB, with a hashed index
svg.text: L12 System level cache lineage: a victim cache grown to 8 MiB, with a hashed index
Left, Jouppi's victim cache and Seznec's skewed index redrawn. Right, the M1 SLC from the measurements. Between them, what was kept, changed and added.
M1 system level cache, 8 MiB, 16 ways, 128 B lines
EXAM and SLAC measured; the rest from patents
victim caching: a line thrown out goes to a small associative cache
Jouppi: no line is in both
four lines remove most conflict misses of 4 KiB
skewed associativity: each bank indexed by its own hash
the skewed cache is Fig. 4 of the 1993 paper, not Fig. 1
filled only by the victims above
8 MiB and 16 ways, not four lines
all ways share the set, not skewed
a DRAM read beside the lookup
filled by L2 victims: a CPU miss goes past it to DRAM
measured: 8 MiB, 16 ways, 128 B, exclusive, victim filled
every one of the 12 index bits is an XOR of address bits
the idea survives, the structure does not
Jouppi backed one small cache; the SLC backs a die
